result.brief: 提出 HarnessWAM 智能体框架，用 VLM 任务管理器与双时间尺度反馈闭环，把世界动作模型的局部预测扩展为可规划、可验证、可恢复的具身任务执行。
result.reason: World Action Models with VLM task manager, structured state maintenance and closed-loop planning for embodied control; explicitly addresses world-model-based planning and long-horizon execution.
